product_overview: CareerBoost is an AI-powered career development assistant designed specifically for B.Tech AI & Data Science students. It provides a comprehensive platform to discover industry certifications, internships, hackathons, latest tech news, AI tools, and project ideas to accelerate career growth.
core_goals: Enable students to efficiently discover and apply for relevant career opportunities like certificates, internships, and hackathons.
Provide up-to-date and curated tech news and AI tools to keep students informed and equipped.
Offer inspirational project ideas and generate customized projects to build strong portfolios.
Facilitate user engagement through a personalized dashboard, authentication, and saved item management.
Ensure a smooth, responsive, and modern user experience leveraging a robust tech stack.
key_features: User Authentication with login and signup modals supporting JWT-based sessions.
Dashboard showcasing an overview of career metrics and quick access to key features.
Certificate Explorer to browse, search, and save career-relevant certifications.
Internship Board with filtering and application capabilities.
Hackathon Hub to discover and save upcoming hackathons with prize details.
Tech News feed offering the latest updates in AI, Cybersecurity, and Data Science.
AI Tools Directory to explore recommended ML and AI tools for various skill levels.
Project Generator for curated and on-demand project ideas to build portfolios.
Saved Items management allowing users to bookmark certificates, internships, and hackathons.
Support for dark/light themes, responsive design, and smooth animations for enhanced UX.
user_flow_summary: User lands on the homepage and views the dashboard with career metrics and quick links.
User registers or logs in through modal dialogs; session credentials are managed via JWT tokens.
User navigates to Certificate Explorer, searches for relevant certifications, and saves favorites.
User browses the Internship Board, filters listings by location and stipend, and applies to suitable opportunities.
User checks the Hackathon Hub for upcoming events and bookmarks those of interest.
User reads the latest Tech News by category or search and stays updated with industry trends.
User explores the AI Tools directory to find recommended tools tailored to their skill level.
User generates or views project ideas to enhance their portfolio.
User accesses and manages saved items like certificates, internships, and hackathons from their dashboard.
User updates their profile and skills as needed, ensuring personal data is synchronized.
validation_criteria: User authentication workflows must securely allow registration, login, token verification, and session management without backend database failures.
All data fetching features (certificates, internships, hackathons, news, tools, projects) should retrieve and display up-to-date, relevant content without errors.
Search and filter functionalities in Certificates and Internships must return accurate and timely results.
Bookmarking/saving functionality must reliably store and retrieve user saved items during the session.
The UI must be responsive, with smooth animations, and support dark/light mode toggling as designed.
API endpoints should return appropriate HTTP status codes and handle errors gracefully.
The application must function fully in a self-contained mode without dependency on a live database, using mock data as fallback.
Deployment scripts and Docker configurations must allow easy setup of frontend, backend, and database components for both local and cloud environments.
